description: This file contains the implementation of the Surfaces class within the wayland namespace, including methods for setting callbacks, handling frame updates, and surface creation/destruction events.

classes.name: Surfaces
classes.description: A class managing Wayland surface events and callbacks, including frame updates and surface lifecycle events.

methods.name: void SetFrameCallback(FrameCallback callback)
methods.description: Sets the callback to be invoked when a new frame is available.

methods.name: void SetDisplayEventCallback(DisplayEventCallback callback)
methods.description: Sets the callback to be invoked on display events such as creation and destruction.

methods.name: void SetFramesAreRGBA(bool frames_are_rgba)
methods.description: Configures whether the frames are in RGBA format, affecting how frame format is handled.

methods.name: void HandleSurfaceFrame(std::uint32_t display_number,std::uint32_t frame_width,std::uint32_t frame_height,std::uint32_t frame_fourcc_format,std::uint32_t frame_stride_bytes,std::uint8_t * frame_bytes)
methods.description: Handles a new surface frame, invokes the frame callback with frame details.

methods.name: void HandleSurfaceCreated(std::uint32_t display_number,std::uint32_t display_width,std::uint32_t display_height)
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new surface, invoking the display event callback.

methods.name: void HandleSurfaceDestroyed(std::uint32_t display_number)
methods.description: Handles destruction of a surface, invoking the display event callback.

ctags.name: HandleSurfaceFrame
ctags.signature: (std::uint32_t display_number,std::uint32_t frame_width,std::uint32_t frame_height,std::uint32_t frame_fourcc_format,std::uint32_t frame_stride_bytes,std::uint8_t * frame_bytes)
